thread.title: An Apple-Tesla Deal Is Unlikely; Here's Why

title: An Apple-Tesla Deal Is Unlikely; Here's Why
text:
An Apple-Tesla Deal Is Unlikely; Here's Why By Ed Ponsi | Sep 4, 2018 | 8:31 AM EDT
When Warren Buffett appeared on Fox Business last week, he was asked a variety of questions about Apple Inc. (AAPL) . Buffett described the iPhone as "enormously underpriced" and indicated that his company, Berkshire Hathaway Inc. (BRK.B) , has continued to accumulate shares of the consumer tech giant, which is a holding of Jim Cramer's Action Alerts PLUS charitable trust.
Then Buffett was questioned about the potential for Apple to acquire controversial automaker Tesla Inc. (TSLA) . After all, Apple has accumulated nearly a quarter trillion dollars in cash and Tesla's market cap is just $52 billion. Buffett minced no words, describing the idea as a "very poor deal." Why pay for Tesla, reasoned Buffett, when "It does not give you a permanent advantage?"...313
